page: Vultr vcg-a40-4c-20g-8vram is a fractional GPU instance within the Cloud GPU family. It features an Intel x86_64 architecture with 4 shared vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores, running at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 20.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.0 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via a fractional NVIDIA Ampere A40 GPU with a 0.1667 allocation, providing 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage consists of a 360 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results demonstrate highly polarized performance characteristics. The fractional NVIDIA A40 GPU delivers top-tier performance in LLM inference workloads, achieving 9881.81 tokens per second for prompt processing and 465.27 tokens per second for text generation on small models, alongside 3161.22 tokens per second for prompt processing on medium models. Conversely, CPU-bound and database tasks show limitations. The shared CPU allocation results in weak performance for PassMark database operations and CPU encryption, as well as poor multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Standard CPU and memory benchmarks, such as stress-ng and PassMark CPU, fall within the average range.

This instance offers a cost-effective entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads by utilizing fractional hardware resources. By partitioning the NVIDIA A40 GPU and sharing CPU cores, the platform provides access to modern Ampere architecture and dedicated VRAM without the expense of a full GPU. However, the shared CPU allocation and lower clock speed introduce performance tradeoffs, making it less suitable for heavy multi-threaded CPU processing or high-throughput database operations.

The vcg-a40-4c-20g-8vram is optimized for small to medium machine learning inference, lightweight AI model deployment, and GPU-accelerated development environments. It is also suitable for general-purpose workloads that require moderate compute and memory alongside local NVMe storage, but it is not recommended for intensive database hosting, cryptography, or high-concurrency web serving.
description: Vultr vcg-a40-4c-20g-8vram is a fractional GPU instance designed for entry-level accelerated workloads. Powered by an Intel x86_64 processor with 4 shared vCPUs and 20.0 GB of system memory, the instance features a fractional NVIDIA Ampere A40 GPU providing 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Storage is supported by a 360 GB NVMe SSD. In benchmark testing, the instance excels in machine learning tasks, delivering top-tier LLM inference speeds for small and medium models. However, the shared CPU architecture introduces tradeoffs, resulting in weak database operations and encryption performance, alongside average general compute scores. This resource profile offers a cost-efficient option for developers needing GPU acceleration without the cost of a dedicated card. It is best suited for lightweight AI inference, model prototyping, and general-purpose tasks requiring moderate GPU acceleration.
